name: IAN Media Library · Construction: excavator

title.zh: IAN Media Library · 先选科学图形再核素材署名

description.zh: 进单素材页核对作者和文件类型。 科学传播图形资源入口，含生态、物种与工程图解，也收录照片等其他媒体。已核的Construction: excavator插画由Roshni Nair-Gonzalez署名，适用CC BY-SA 4.0；其他条目逐项核授权，图形文件不等于公开程序源码。
description.en: A science-communication media library with ecological, species and engineering illustrations alongside photos and other media. The verified Construction: excavator artwork is credited to Roshni Nair-Gonzalez under CC BY-SA 4.0. Other entries require individual rights checks; editable graphic files do not establish public program source code.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by IAN Media Library (https://ian.umces.edu/media-library/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 进单素材页核对作者和文件类型。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先在库首页对照挖掘机、植物图解与冰川照片，再进入 Symbols 页比较鸟类、昆虫、鱼类和工程图形。单件挖掘机详情把原预览、作者与文件类型放在一起，方便记录素材出处，但本次没有筛选、下载或编辑。该作品按 CC BY-SA 署名，分享改编时须使用相同或兼容许可；全库还有其他媒体，不能把一件图形的授权套给全部条目。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
